title: Compute once per key
hints: Between RUnlock and Lock, other goroutines can run the same check, see the same miss, and compute too. A read lock followed by a write lock is not one atomic step.
After taking the write lock, check the map again: another goroutine may have stored the value while you waited. Compute only if it's still missing, while holding the lock.
c.mu.RLock(); v, ok := c.data[key]; c.mu.RUnlock(); if ok { return v }; c.mu.Lock(); defer c.mu.Unlock(); if v, ok := c.data[key]; ok { return v }; v = compute(); c.data[key] = v; return v
